item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description:
Today, let's talk Eating.
Your calendar shows a dinner slot and a lot of reminders about pausing and checking in. Use that same habit with food. Before you eat, ask whether you're hungry or reacting to stress. Eat at regular times, sit down, and put the phone away. Skipping meals usually sets up a rushed, reactive evening.
Your action: before your next meal, take one slow breath and ask what your body needs.
